decisions.reason: As a core safety-shoe line that moved from a general mention in 2023 to its own page in 2024, it appears to be gaining enough traction in the firm's main business to justify continued investment.

Although only mentioned rather than heavily promoted, this comfort insole is a low-cost complementary option within the firm's footwear system and can remain on the market while demand potential continues to resolve.

This supportive insole also fits the firm's tailored-solution strategy and likely requires limited incremental resources to keep available, so the option value of staying in market still outweighs dropping it.
The ergonomic safety shoe series had its own page in both 2023 and 2024, indicating sustained strategic emphasis and enough positive signal to continue backing it.
Firefighter and rescue boots progressed from a mention in 2023 to a dedicated page in 2024, suggesting improving prospects in a specialized adjacent segment worth continuing.
The moulded insole remained on the home page and is backed by a specific 2024 customer-use example, which signals visible market acceptance and strong fit with the firm's customization capabilities.
